about_the_game:
《CyberMaid》— Your Personal Maid, Always by Your Side!

✨ The Cutest Desktop Maid to Brighten Up Your PC! ✨

Want to make your desktop more fun and lively? CyberMaid is a charming interactive desktop application. Your personal maid will always keep an eye on your mouse movements, providing a sense of companionship and making your work and gaming moments more relaxing!

🌹 Main Features:

💖 Adorable Eye-Tracking: Her eyes will follow your mouse movements, making you feel her attention!

💬 Easy and Fun Interactions: Click on specific parts of her to trigger cute reactions and discover more surprises!

🔥 Perfect for These Users:

✔ Fans of anime characters and maid culture

✔ Students, office workers, and streamers who want desktop companionship

✔ Gamers who love customizing their desktop with aesthetics and fun

💠💠💠💠💠💠💠💠💠

🎮 How to Use 🎮

🖱 Left Click: Drag to move the maid

🖱 Double Left Click: Open settings menu

🖱 Right Click: Interact with the maid and trigger cute reactions

🎡 Mouse Wheel Scroll: Adjust the maid’s zoom level

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes interactive physics simulation, allowing players to touch female characters' bodies using the mouse or controller. For example, the character’s chest will respond to player input with physical reactions, such as movement in the direction of applied force or natural jiggle effects. This feature is purely a gameplay mechanic and does not include nudity, sexual acts, or explicit content. All characters remain fully clothed.

The game does not depict non-consensual actions, violence, or other sensitive material. All interactions occur within the designed feedback mechanics of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Six-core Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: 💖 CyberMaid – Your Caring Desktop Maid! She accompanies and interacts with you, bringing warmth to your computer! Whether for work, study, or entertainment, make your desktop more lovable and unique!
